title: PAR-138 DetailViewStyle group-1 color insertion fast slice
mode: Generated ASCII/Binary implementation and focused regression validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Insert absent DetailViewStyle group-1 identifier/arrow color values (DXF group 62) from edited typed values during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve occurrence mapping when the identifier color is default and only the arrow color changes by inserting the default identifier-color slot first.
Validate generated ASCII and Binary source/output behavior with typed readback, exact ordered raw-group comparisons, and unchanged neighboring style carrier.

implementation.behavior: The DetailViewStyle overlay now detects missing group-1 identifier and arrow colors. Non-default identifier color is inserted before the arrow color. If only the arrow color is non-default and the identifier occurrence is missing, insert the typed/default identifier color as the first group-62 occurrence, then insert the arrow color. Newly inserted colors are constrained to signed 16-bit values.
testCases: Remove both group-1 group-62 colors from a generated primary DetailViewStyle; confirm both parse as default 256, change only arrow color to 19, export/read back in ASCII and Binary DXF, and assert identifier remains 256 while arrow is 19.
Compare the complete ordered raw DetailViewStyle group stream and untouched SectionViewStyle carrier after replay.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
No native style-rendering or broad DetailViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
No commit was created because the shared worktree's .git directory is read-only.
